rewrites._comment: SPA fallback for deep links (/login, /profile, /diary, /goal-setup, /results). The negative lookahead excludes anything with a file extension so real assets are served before the fallback rather than being rewritten to index.html.

headers._comment: Entry points must revalidate, otherwise a cached index.html keeps pointing at a deleted build.
CanvasKit ships under a version-pinned path, so immutable is safe here.
Flutter asset filenames are NOT content-hashed, so a one-year immutable cache would pin users to stale assets across deploys. Short TTL with revalidation instead.
